doc.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Staying with the Shacklefords and the cast of the Hollywood picture
summary: She lodged in a private home in Hollywood and recalls the circus-like film with Cab, Eleanor Powell, Woody Herman, Sophie Tucker and Gene Rodgers.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: When you arrived in Hollywood, did they put you in a special hotel, could you stay in the hotels or did they put you in a rooming house?
No, I stayed with the Shacklefords, someone’s personal home.
And you stayed there how long?
We stayed there about four or five weeks.
Do you have a print of the movie?

It’s easy to get. Eleanor Powell, Cab, Woody Herman and Sophie Tucker. It was a circus. And Gene Rodgers and I played against each other. He was a very good pianist. Cab was directing and shaking his hair.
Oh yeah, sometimes it wouldn’t shake because he’d put some grease on it (both laugh).
